y9-11g-q2a.question: Find the equation of the line that is parallel to the line \(y = 3x - 1\) and passes through the point \((2, 7)\).
y9-11g-q2a.hint: Parallel lines have the same gradient. Find the gradient of the given line, then use point-gradient form.
y9-11g-q2a.solution:
1. The gradient of the parallel line is same as \(y = 3x - 1\), which is \(m = 3\).
2. Use Point-Slope formula \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\) with point \((2, 7)\):
   \(y - 7 = 3(x - 2)\)
   \(y = 3x + 1\).
